title: Pick a card reader
ask: We start at the weekend market next month and need a card reader. I've put three in sources/options.md. Write me a brief on which to get.
background: We expect about $3,000 of card sales a month to begin with.
The market has patchy phone signal, so it has to take payments offline and send them later.
A rep from Tapwell left a card at the stall and I don't want to be on his call list.

constraints.text: quote fees as percentages, and none above 1.9%
put your pick under a heading called "Recommendation"
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
don't contact Tapwell or any other vendor
do actually open sources/options.md rather than going from memory
say when the money reaches our account

start.sources/options.md:
